3.title: Survey the iron site and logistics
3.body: Record node throughput, water access and transport routes. Reserve the whole iron footprint before placing the first hall.

3.title: Retire the temporary power plants
3.body: Test the turbofuel plant on its own supply first. Retire 16 coal generators and eight temporary fuel generators at 250%. Keep shared infrastructure and all compacted coal for turbofuel and trucks. Retained capacity: 44.425 GW.

3.title: Build the first three iron halls
3.body: Build one 30-refinery hall and verify it, then add two more for the full Phase 3 target: 90 Pure Iron refineries at 100%, producing 5,850 ingots/min from 3,150 ore + 1,800 water/min. This covers 5,100/min downstream plus 10/min protected storage, leaving 740/min overflow. Refinery power: 1,350 MW at half consumption. Reserve space and connection routes for 13 halls, but leave the remaining ten unbuilt until later phases.

3.title: Concrete, copper and construction supplies
3.body: Build Wet Concrete, Pure Copper, plates and rods. Pure Copper starts at 6,300/min. Reserve the later copper expansion area.

3.title: Steel and structural components
3.body: Build Solid Steel, pipes, beams, reinforced plates, modular frames, encased beams and heavy frames. Supply every protected storage allowance.

3.title: Oil and electronics
3.body: Build the Phase 3 oil campus. Convert heavy oil residue to residual fuel and burn it so the plastic and rubber lines keep running. Add circuit boards and computers.

3.title: Mechanical parts and wiring
3.body: Build rotors, stators, motors and Automated Wiring. Make bulk wire and screws beside the factories that consume them.

3.title: Permanent project-part factories
3.body: Build Smart Plating, Modular Engines and Adaptive Control Units. Add 5 Versatile Frameworks/min for storage even though their delivery is complete.

3.title: Deliver Phase 3
3.body: Net exports: 50 Modular Engines/min and 10 ACU/min. Each remaining target takes 500 minutes at steady state. Keep storage and downstream allocations separate.

4.title: Unlock aluminum, logistics and nitrogen
4.body: Progress through Tier 7/8 unlocks and secure the selected alternate recipes. Build starter batches before scaling.

4.title: Two rocket-fuel power blocks
4.body: Build two 72 GW blocks, one at a time. Retained turbofuel plus these blocks gives 188.425 GW gross.

4.title: Expand iron to ten halls
4.body: Before expanding steel and other iron consumers, add seven 30-refinery halls (+210 refineries). Total: 300 refineries at 100%, 19,500 ingots/min, 10,500 ore/min, 6,000 water/min and 4,500 MW refinery power. This covers 18,860/min including protected storage, with 640/min overflow. Add halls as consumers come online; retain space for three more.

4.title: Expand metals and replace the oil campus
4.body: Use the Phase 4 factory targets. Switch to fused wire, fused quickwire, steamed copper sheets and the recycled oil campus. Fuel exported from oil is reserved for Heat-Fused Frames.

4.title: Advanced component factories
4.body: Build aluminum products, oscillators, cooling systems, radio control units, fused frames, pressure cubes, turbo motors, supercomputers and batteries.

4.title: Waste processing before uranium power
4.body: Build the complete waste-processing chain first. Sink 2.5 Plutonium Fuel Rods/min; do not burn them yet. Then commission 50 uranium reactors for 125 GW. Total gross capacity: 313.425 GW.

4.title: Deliver Phase 4
4.body: Net exports: 50 ADS, 50 MFG, 25 TPR and 10 Pasta/min. Each target takes 500 minutes. Retain larger installed factories if Phase 5 demand falls.

5.title: Verify the resource and power gates
5.body: The resource table includes all retained power, truck-fuel production and six new rocket-fuel blocks. Verify at least 12,460 Nitrogen/min from your randomized wells. Check transport capacity as well as extraction.

5.title: Expand to six rocket-fuel blocks
5.body: Add four more 72 GW blocks, taking fuel-only gross generation to 476.425 GW including retained turbofuel. Keep power production independent of factory load shedding.

5.title: Matter Conversion and extra Reanimated SAM
5.body: Before the full supply expansion, build 165 Converters across four lines. Expand Reanimated SAM to 5,250/min using 175 Constructors. Reserve 1,650/min for resource conversion.

5.title: Complete the final three iron halls
5.body: Before the final conventional supply expansion, add three halls (+90 refineries). Total: 390 refineries at 100%, 25,350 ingots/min, 13,650 ore/min, 7,800 water/min and 5,850 MW refinery power. This covers 23,460/min including protected storage, with 1,890/min overflow. Supply the Coal Converters separately with 12,600 raw iron/min; do not send that ore through the ingot campus.

5.title: Expand the conventional supply chain
5.body: Install the Phase 5 metal, oil and component capacities before connecting quantum factories. Retain any larger Phase 4 capacity.

5.title: Quantum and SAM production
5.body: Build the quantum chain. Reuse returned Dark Matter Residue before producing fresh residue. Bootstrap limited output for nuclear commissioning.

5.title: Complete zero-waste nuclear
5.body: Build Ficsonium processing and burning capacity before routing plutonium rods away from the sink. Final fleet: 100 uranium, 50 plutonium and 25 Ficsonium reactors, generating 437.5 GW gross.

5.title: Keep ten portal pairs connected
5.body: Reserve 20 Singularity Cells/min for ten portal pairs, plus 5/min protected storage. Nuclear processing has a separate allocation. Protect and buffer portal supply.

5.title: Deliver Phase 5
5.body: Net exports: 100 Pasta, 100 Sculptors, 25 AI Servers and 20 Warp Drives/min. Final delivery takes about 8h32 at steady state. Final gross capacity: 913.925 GW.

post.title: Make storage the first priority
post.body: Keep every protected storage allowance. Reduce former elevator-export production when the additional completion factories need those resources. Continue sinking the remaining project-part surplus; full delivery rates are optional.

post.title: Finish the remaining manufactured items
post.body: Build ammunition, filters, packaging and other completion modules. Their inputs are additional to the main resource budget: allocate supply before connecting them.

post.title: Finish the workshop beneath Q/R
post.body: Craft Bench and Equipment Workshop near the entrance; tools and mobility equipment on the left, weapons and spare wearables on the right. Put the MAM and collectables intake at the rear. Keep ammo and filters in G/H.

post.title: Connect the collectables sorter
post.body: Q/R upstairs hold collected ingredients, slugs, food and discoveries. Use exact item filters and send the remaining overflow to a recovery chest rather than sinking mixed collectables.

post.title: Test the finished network
post.body: Check storage-full operation, fluid returns, fuel supply and load shedding. Keep radioactive materials at the nuclear site. A blocked downstream nuclear process must stop new uranium fuel input.

post.title: Review later upgrades
post.body: More portal pairs or converting retained turbofuel to rocket fuel require a separate input and power recalculation. No benefit from those optional upgrades is counted yet.

Add 7 halls in Phase 4 (300 total refineries, 19,500/min), then 3 halls in Phase 5 (390 total, 25,350/min). Every refinery runs at 100%. Full campus: 13,650 ore + 7,800 water/min. The separate 12,600 raw iron/min for Phase 5 Coal Converters bypasses this campus. Keep any extra halls already built available; no demolition is needed.

storageTasks.title: Ground-floor structure built
storageTasks.body: Already built in your save. Individual container connections are not assumed complete.

storageTasks.title: Put the filters together
storageTasks.body: Keep Iodine-Infused Filters in H01. Move standard Nobelisks from H02 to H08. Move Gas Filters from G08 to H02. Assign Medicinal Inhalers to G08.

storageTasks.title: Build upper-floor bays I-P
storageTasks.body: Keep the assigned addresses. Bay Q goes behind O; R goes behind P.

storageTasks.title: Add collectables bays Q/R
storageTasks.body: Continue the upper main aisle into the rear extension. Filter each collected item by its exact name; send leftovers to a recovery chest.

storageTasks.title: Workshop underneath Q/R
storageTasks.body: Craft Bench and Equipment Workshop at the entrance; tools left, weapons and spare wearables right; MAM and inventory drop at the rear. No production-container address changes.
